issues.title: WW-01: Repository scaffold
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M0 Foundations

Vite, React and TypeScript (strict) app with ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, Playwright, and an installable web app manifest and service worker (vite-plugin-pwa). Folder layout: `src/app`, `src/features/<module>`, `src/data`, `src/map`, `src/lib`, `rules/`, `tests/`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `npm run dev`, `build`, `typecheck`, `lint`, `test` all succeed
- [ ] A Lighthouse installability check passes on the built app
- [ ] README explains every script
- [ ] No em dashes in code or copy

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/firebase-architecture.md`

issues.title: WW-02: Firebase emulator setup
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M0 Foundations

`firebase.json` with Auth and Firestore emulators, project id `demo-wavewatch`, `firebase-tools` as a dev dependency, `npm run emu` script, seed script with clearly fake data only.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] The app connects to the emulators when `VITE_USE_EMULATOR=1`
- [ ] The seed script loads fake data marked `demo: true`
- [ ] No Firebase login or real project is needed or referenced

**Depends on:** WW-01

issues.title: WW-03: CI workflow, manual only
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M0 Foundations

GitHub Actions workflow that runs typecheck, lint, unit tests and rules tests against the emulator. Trigger `workflow_dispatch` only (private-repository minutes not checked).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Workflow file valid (`actionlint` or a dry parse)
- [ ] Runs nothing on push

**Depends on:** WW-02

issues.title: WW-04: Design tokens and app shell
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M0 Foundations

Phone-first shell matching the artifact: bottom tabs Map, Log, Cases, Ops, Insights, More; light and dark themes from CSS tokens; the artifact's type scale and colours as the starting point.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Usable at 360 px width with no sideways scroll
- [ ] Light and dark both pass WCAG AA contrast for text
- [ ] Tab state survives reload

**Depends on:** WW-01

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/artifact-poc.md`

issues.title: WW-05: Base map from the OSM extract
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M0 Foundations

MapLibre GL map rendered from `raw/2026-10-20_osm-jeffreys-bay-extract.json` converted at build time to GeoJSON (roads by class, coast, water, green, places, points of interest). No external tile server. OpenStreetMap attribution shown.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Map loads offline after first visit
- [ ] Pan and zoom smooth on a mid-range phone (Chrome device emulation, 4x CPU slowdown)
- [ ] Conversion script is tested and reproducible

**Depends on:** WW-01

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/research/2026-10-20_research_osm-map-extract.md`

issues.title: WW-06: Sign-in
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M1 Accounts and data

Firebase Authentication with email and password, and Google. Sign-out, password reset. Phone sign-in is WW-36.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Works against the Auth emulator
- [ ] Signed-out users see only the sign-in screen
- [ ] No personal data in URLs

**Depends on:** WW-02

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/decisions/2026-10-20_decision-sign-in-methods.md`

issues.title: WW-07: Organisations, members and invites
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M1 Accounts and data

`orgs/{orgId}` with `members/{uid}` (role, invitedBy, joinedAt). Coordinator creates invites (email plus role); invitee joins on sign-in. Roles coordinator, analyst, responder, viewer.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] First user of a new org becomes coordinator
- [ ] A coordinator can change roles and remove members
- [ ] Invites expire after 14 days

**Depends on:** WW-06

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/decisions/2026-10-20_decision-roles.md`

issues.title: WW-08: Security rules v1 with tests
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M1 Accounts and data

Firestore rules for the matrix in the security model: deny by default, membership check, role checks, field types, allowed values, maximum lengths. Rules unit tests with `@firebase/rules-unit-testing`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A test per role per collection, allowed and refused
- [ ] Cross-organisation read refused (test)
- [ ] Responder cannot read cases (test)
- [ ] Deletes are coordinator only (test)

**Depends on:** WW-07

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/security-model.md`

issues.title: WW-09: Typed data layer
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M1 Accounts and data

Zod schemas and Firestore converters for every collection in the data model; repository functions per collection; live queries as React hooks.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Every write passes schema validation before it is sent
- [ ] Unit tests for each schema with valid and invalid examples
- [ ] Schemas match the artifact backup shape (fixture test)

**Depends on:** WW-07

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/data-model.md`

issues.title: WW-10: Audit log
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M1 Accounts and data

Append-only `audit` entries (at, uid, action, path) for deletes, role changes, imports, exports and purges. Coordinator-only view.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Rules forbid update and delete on audit (test)
- [ ] Each listed action writes one entry (test)

**Depends on:** WW-08

issues.title: WW-11: Offline persistence and sync status
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M1 Accounts and data

Firestore persistent local cache (multi-tab). A status chip: Saved, Saving, Offline (n waiting).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Log 10 incidents in airplane mode (emulated), reload, reconnect: all 10 synced once
- [ ] Status chip reflects each state (Playwright)

**Depends on:** WW-09

issues.title: WW-12: Incident log with privacy guard
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M2 Core logging

Quick log and full form as in the artifact: 22 types in 8 groups, time or time window, approximate flag, area, street, map pin, method, items, description, vehicle description, source, SAPS status and CAS, follow-up. Privacy guard warns on names, phone, ID and plate patterns and house numbers before save.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Quick log in under 20 seconds on a phone (manual check, recorded)
- [ ] Guard catches the patterns from the intake test set
- [ ] Edit history kept per incident

**Depends on:** WW-09,WW-05

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/intake-and-redaction.md`

issues.title: WW-13: Map view of incidents
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M2 Core logging

Pins by type colour, heat layer, filters (type group, period, area, SAPS status), replay by time, tap a pin for a summary card.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] 500 fake incidents render without jank (4x CPU slowdown)
- [ ] Filters and replay match the artifact behaviour

**Depends on:** WW-12,WW-05

issues.title: WW-14: Reports feed and grading
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M2 Core logging

Feed of raw reports with source reliability A to F and credibility 1 to 6, link to incident, case or operation, or dismiss with a reason. Manual entry and paste of a WhatsApp export with on-device redaction (no AI yet; the coordinator splits items by hand).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Parser and redaction pass the intake test set (senders, phone, ID, plates, system and media lines)
- [ ] Linked and dismissed reports leave the feed

**Depends on:** WW-09

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/intake-and-redaction.md`

issues.title: WW-15: Contacts and role-player presets
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M2 Core logging

Contacts list (organisation, role, phone, notes) and presets used by operations.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Responders can read contacts; viewers cannot (rules test)

**Depends on:** WW-09

issues.title: WW-16: Settings
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M2 Core logging

Areas (15 suburbs default), sources with default reliability, near-repeat distance and days, retention months. Coordinator edits; others read.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Changing near-repeat settings changes alerts immediately
- [ ] Defaults match the artifact

**Depends on:** WW-09

issues.title: WW-17: Cases and series
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M3 Cases and analysis

Cases with subjects (descriptions only), sightings route on the map, tasks, hypotheses, evidence handover register, series links, status open, with SAPS, closed.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Sightings draw a timed route
- [ ] Handover register captures holder, window, hash or reference, receiver and CAS

**Depends on:** WW-13

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/privacy-and-evidence.md`

issues.title: WW-18: Cameras and canvass
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M3 Cases and analysis

Camera registry with direction, field of view and range drawn on the map; canvass statuses per case; footage request text generator.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Camera cones render correctly at all zoom levels
- [ ] Canvass status per camera per case persists

**Depends on:** WW-17

issues.title: WW-19: Gap streets and likely exit routes
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M3 Cases and analysis

Port `coverage` (650 m radius, camera within 45 m) and `exitRoutes` (direction from the last two sightings) from the artifact.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Unit tests reproduce the artifact results on the fixture case

**Depends on:** WW-18

issues.title: WW-20: Series matching
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M3 Cases and analysis

Port `matchCases` scoring (threshold 45) to suggest linked cases.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Unit tests reproduce the artifact scores on fixtures

**Depends on:** WW-17

issues.title: WW-21: Patterns, near-repeats, repeat locations
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M3 Cases and analysis

Time of day and day of week charts, near-repeat alerts (default 400 m, 14 days), repeat locations, response times.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Near-repeat toast on save when applicable
- [ ] Charts readable at 360 px

**Depends on:** WW-13,WW-16

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/concepts/Near-repeat.md`

issues.title: WW-22: SAPS liaison
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M3 Cases and analysis

Referral summary, follow-up list, case pack generator, monthly report.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Generated text has no names or identifying numbers (test)

**Depends on:** WW-17

issues.title: WW-23: Station statistics by quarter
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M3 Cases and analysis

Enter published station statistics by South African financial-year quarter (`q-YYYY-M`) and compare with logged incidents.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Quarter labels match the artifact `quarters()` function (test)

**Depends on:** WW-09

issues.title: WW-24: Live operations
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M4 Operations and patrols

Operations of six kinds with response log, timeline, search sectors drawn and cleared, last known position, sightings, live presence of viewers (Firestore listeners).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Two browsers see each other's timeline entries within 2 seconds on the emulator

**Depends on:** WW-13,WW-15

issues.title: WW-25: Close, minimise and after-action
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M4 Operations and patrols

Closing an operation clears `personNote`, logs the minimisation, and generates the after-action report with no personal details.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] personNote empty after close (test)
- [ ] After-action text passes the privacy guard (test)

**Depends on:** WW-24

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/specs/privacy-and-evidence.md`

issues.title: WW-26: Patrol planner and effect check
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M4 Operations and patrols

Port `patrolZones` (250 m grid, 10-day half-life, at most 4 zones); log patrols; compare incidents before and after.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Unit tests reproduce the artifact zones on fixtures

**Depends on:** WW-21

issues.title: WW-27: Briefs from templates
issues.body:
**Milestone:** M4 Operations and patrols

Intelligence brief and resident bulletin from templates (AI version is WW-34). Bulletin names suburbs and time bands only and warns on street names or numbers.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Bulletin warning fires on a street name (test)

**Depends on:** WW-21

**Depends on:** WW-09

**Spec:** `WaveWatch-Wiki/wiki/runbooks/migrate-artifact-data.md`

issues.title: WW-29: Exports

issues.title: WW-34: AI extraction, AI briefs and Ask

**Depends on:** WW-33

issues.title: WW-36: Phone sign-in

SMS sign-in for responders.

**Acceptance criteria**

issues.title: WW-37: Community features

Resident camera census form, footage expiry countdown on cases, street warnings to residents.
